1: %% notation.tex
2: %% Shared manuscript source, extracted verbatim from the historical
3: %% entry point paper/main.tex (lines 55-64) so that it and the TMLR
4: %% entry point submissions/tmlr_2026/main.tex read one copy of this
5: %% material instead of two. Content is unchanged by the extraction
6: %% itself. The revision the lines refer to is recorded in
7: %% paper/EXPOSITION_REVISION.md, which is not part of any submission
8: %% upload.
9: \newcommand{\epsCGbar}{\bar\varepsilon_{\mathrm{CG}}}
10: % --- notation introduced by the dynamic-transfer revision ------------------
11: \newcommand{\bh}{\mathbf{h}}                     % played gradient feature h_t
12: \newcommand{\Calg}{\mathcal{C}}                 % generic pre-reward SPD algorithmic curvature
13: \newcommand{\Lamalg}{\Lambda^{\Calg}}           % realized width complexity
14: \newcommand{\Valg}{V^{\Calg}}                   % determinant-destroying variation charge
15: \newcommand{\Gamdyn}{\Gamma^{\mathrm{dyn}}}     % dynamic potential bound
16: \newcommand{\Gmat}{\mathsf{G}}                  % whitened frozen-feature columns
17: \newcommand{\Dmat}{\mathsf{D}}                  % whitened replayed-drift columns
18: \newcommand{\cHist}{\mathcal{H}}                % pre-reward history sigma-algebra H_t
19: 
20: % --- venue-dependent rendering of the generated evidence tables ------------
21: % The three evidence tables are generated from the locked aggregate and carry
22: % one fixed `tabular` preamble (all r/l columns), so every column header is set
23: % on a single line and the widest table overruns a one-column text block.
24: %
25: % The historical two-column AISTATS entry point scaled them to the text width.
26: % The TMLR submission must not: that venue forbids reducing font size or
27: % spacing to fit content, and scaling a \scriptsize table had put the rendered
28: % text near 6pt against 9.96pt body copy.  It instead sets each table on a
29: % landscape float at the body font size, with the template's \tabcolsep, and
30: % supplies its own column widths so that the long headers wrap.  Every cell,
31: % value, unit, qualifier and rule still comes from the generated file exactly
32: % as generated; only the column widths and the float type belong to the
33: % manuscript.
34: %
35: % \evidencetabular{<column preamble>}{<\input of the generated table>}
36: %   discards the generated `tabular` preamble and substitutes the one given
37: %   here.  Nothing else about the table is touched.
38: % \ccetablesize is the size command for the hand-written (non-generated)
39: %   tables; empty in the submission, \scriptsize in the legacy layout.
40: \iflegacyextras
41:   \newenvironment{ccewidefloat}{\begin{table*}[t]\centering}{\end{table*}}
42:   \newenvironment{ccewidefloatappendix}{\begin{table}[H]\centering}{\end{table}}
43:   \newcommand{\ccetablesize}{\scriptsize}
44:   \newcommand{\evidencetabular}[2]{\scriptsize\resizebox{\textwidth}{!}{#2}}
45: \else
46:   \newenvironment{ccewidefloat}%
47:     {\begin{sidewaystable}[p]\centering}{\end{sidewaystable}}
48:   \newenvironment{ccewidefloatappendix}%
49:     {\begin{sidewaystable}[p]\centering}{\end{sidewaystable}}
50:   \newcommand{\ccetablesize}{}
51:   \newcommand{\evidencetabular}[2]{%
52:     \begingroup
53:       \let\ccerealtabular\tabular
54:       \renewcommand{\tabular}[2][c]{\ccerealtabular[##1]{#1}}%
55:       #2%
56:     \endgroup}
57: \fi
